title: Tens and ones
hook: Bundle ice-cream sticks into tens. Then any number is just bundles and loose sticks.

atHome.thing: Ice-cream sticks or straws with rubber bands
atHome.ask: Make bundles of 10. “Show me 36.” Then: “Can you show 36 with only 2 bundles?”
“I have 4 ten-dollar notes and 7 one-dollar coins. How much?”
Point at a number like 52: “How many tens? How many ones?”

tips: Say one sentence often: “Ten ones make one ten. Open a ten, get ten ones back.”
In school questions like “6 tens 14 ones”, count the tens by 10, 20, 30… then add the ones. Check every option.
